description: This file contains functions for interacting with Discord messages, including reading, fetching, editing, deleting, pinning, unpinning, creating threads, listing threads, and searching messages via Discord API.

methods.name: readMessagesDiscord
methods.description: Reads messages from a specified Discord channel with optional query parameters.

methods.name: fetchMessageDiscord
methods.description: Fetches a specific message from a Discord channel by message ID.

methods.name: editMessageDiscord
methods.description: Edits the content of a specific message in a Discord channel.

methods.name: deleteMessageDiscord
methods.description: Deletes a specific message from a Discord channel.

methods.name: pinMessageDiscord
methods.description: Pins a message in a Discord channel.

methods.name: unpinMessageDiscord
methods.description: Unpins a message in a Discord channel.

methods.name: listPinsDiscord
methods.description: Lists all pinned messages in a Discord channel.

methods.name: createThreadDiscord
methods.description: Creates a new thread in a Discord channel, with special handling for forum-like channels.

methods.name: listThreadsDiscord
methods.description: Lists active or archived threads in a Discord channel or guild.

methods.name: searchMessagesDiscord
methods.description: Searches messages within a guild based on content, channel IDs, and author IDs.
